messages:
lina: Heads up — Acme reported an invoice with an extra 'reserved_burst' line for 2024-07-31 near midnight. Dashboard shows nothing for that window. tagging @samir @margo for billing run

samir: On it. Can you paste invoice id + account id?

lina: Invoice INV-2024-07-ACME-4521, account acme-corp-92. Customer attached CSV; uploading billing export: https://redwood-data/exports/1724999999-acme-invoice.csv

margo: Quick glance: invoice line type 'reserved_burst_usage' at 2024-07-31T00:00:05Z. Dashboard ingestion cutoff is 00:00:00Z — odd that it materialized only on invoice. Could be backfill or late-arrival double-count.

jess: I see a background embed_batch job scheduled 23:59 that has a retry wrapper. Logs show two successes within ~10s with different job_ids but identical payload. Suspect missing idempotency.

jess: ```sql
SELECT job_id, status, attempts, payload_hash, run_uuid, ts
FROM embed_batch_runs
WHERE account='acme-corp-92' AND ts >= '2024-07-30'
ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 20;
```

carlos: From SRE traces the batch overlapped the midnight cutover; billing aggregator appears to have picked up the second completion as separate usage. Trace id: trace-0a1b2c (attaching).

margo: Billing aggregator groups by (payload_hash, minute) currently. That's fragile when retries complete across minute boundaries. Proposed short-term: add dedupe by run_uuid if present, otherwise ignore duplicates within a 5min window for same account/payload_hash.

samir: For immediate customer remediation we can do a one-off credit. How large is the delta?

lina: Customer reports +48,420 tokens (invoice > dashboard), amount ~$12.07. Need finance approval.

samir: Approve credit of $12.07. I'll record ledger entry and mark invoice adjusted. Note for audit: root cause 'midnight double-complete from embed batch retry; billing aggregator double-counted'.

jess: I'll open a PR to add idempotency checking in the embed pipeline and a dedupe rule in the aggregator. Repro steps locally: 1) run embed_batch attempt=1; 2) simulate retry that returns success with a new job_id but identical payload; 3) run aggregator immediately to observe double-count.

jess: ```bash
# repro script
python scripts/repro_duplicate_embed.py --account acme-corp-92 --simulate-midnight
```

carlos: :white_check_mark: I'll also add a tracing tag to the billing aggregator to surface embed_batch run_uuid in daily usage logs.

billing-bot: Ticket created: #SUP-5981 — Credit issued $12.07 to acme-corp-92. Root cause label added. Assignees: samir, jess, carlos.

lina: Thanks team. I'll reply to the customer: credit issued and fix ETA (next deploy). Will follow up when PR merged/deployed.

jess: PR opened: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1098 — adds idempotency + 5min dedupe fallback. Requesting review from @carlos.

carlos: Reviewing now. If green, can we hotfix billing aggregator tonight? Need to prevent more month-end ghost lines.

samir: I'll sign off on emergency deploy if tests pass. Post back here after deploy status.

lina: :thumbsup:
